title: BYODA calibration =》red triangle in AAPS
body:
@MilosKozak I got the difficult to catch calibrating in BYODA giving a red triangle bug once more. I hope the logs will help you this time.

Around 22h27, I calibrate in BYODA. It was showing sth like 190 and calibration was higher, sth like 215... Next BG read, BYODA and xDrip shows 216 but AAPS shows 195. I look in BYODA tab in AAPS, the time stamp is correct 22:27 but BG is not 216 as in xDrip and BYODA.

5 min later, the BGs aligne on the 3 aps but I get the red triangle in AAPS.

![Screenshot_20220529-183119_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/171057482-29d56146-bd49-4f30-9bbc-0aa0f6d8dee1.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220530-223318_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/171057497-60eacac5-d811-4d07-91bf-dd325afe475f.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220530-223533_xDrip+.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/171057508-2ee2e860-432a-4a3e-9931-07661e6d4b04.jpg)

![20220530_223740.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/171057521-ffdeac8d-e2d8-4e28-a171-554115f5598e.jpg)

And the logs. Look a bit before and after 22:27...

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1653942984156.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8800669/AndroidAPS_LOG_1653942984156.log.zip)

comments.body:
this is impossible to detect from received batch (only 1 wrong value). The only way would be compare with database which would be expensive
I'll keep this open to see if it's rare or not

Ok. It is in fact rare as I didn't have this bug for over a month (and I calibrated around the 5 min delay often).

Will come back if it happens again.

>  ... in fact rare (?)

Interesting. 
Calibrating G6/BUODA often (avg once every 2 days). Haven't seen any red triangles for a long time ...
@vanelsberg You get it when you calibrate just after BYODA got the last reading. Can't say how distant the BG reading and calibration should be...

Weird problem: Have seen this in the past (weeks ago).
I cannot repro this. Tried several times.
Also I calibrate my G6 every 2 days on average. So I should see this at least occasionally

Hi @MilosKozak Got the red triangle once more and this time I was about 3 min after the sensor BG measure. The difference between sensor and blood was important (G6 54 vs blood 70).
